assets.modifications: Original work. Drawn from the reference photographs in assets/refs/ under the rules in assets/style/art-bible.md; never traced. The @1x suffix pins the source to one scale: it is stripped before the texture key is formed, so the key ottawa-landmark-parliament-hill is unchanged and no level document moves. It is a full-width background the player skates past, not something held close to the camera, and at 2x it cost 17.14 MiB of decoded texture - 36% of the level - to sharpen it.

assets.title: TrueNorth character rig contract (machine-readable)
assets.author: TrueNorth contributors
assets.modifications: Original work. The data form of assets/style/rig-contract.md: artboards, state-machine inputs, skin slots, expressions, events, parts and part windows. Its home is content/characters/rig.json once a rig schema exists; the schema fields it needs are listed in section 9 of rig-contract.md and are requested, not assumed.

assets.title: TrueNorth character rig contract fixture (Rive)
assets.author: TrueNorth contributors
assets.modifications: Original work, 363 bytes. Carries ONLY the contract surface - the player and officer artboards, the motion state machine and its nine typed inputs - and no drawable content, so a contract test can assert the Rive and atlas vocabularies agree. Deliberately NOT under assets/src/rive/, so the asset pipeline never emits it and nothing can load it as a character. Byte-for-byte reproducible from the format table and hex dump in assets/style/rig-contract.md section 8.
